items.title: Joe Lyde Interview, 1959-05-18
items.q: Bob Reinders was telling me that there were some kids that he was teaching out at Xavier

ctx.x: With a slightly modern... Yeah, if he can, he doesn't know much about it, but he's interested in the idea. Bob Reinders was telling me that there were some kids that he was teaching out at Xavier, coloured kids, a young, you know, the younger generation, which, you know, are lacking really in the brass band business. They were interested in not letting it die, but somehow the idea fell through.
Well, at least there's an interest.
